title: Submitting your assignment
sentences: First, it is a good idea to read your work and correct spelling mistakes.
When you have corrected all the mistakes, print out your assignment.
Also, remember to print a separate cover sheet and attach it to your assignment.
You hand your assignment and attached document to the front desk in the office.
A staff member will check and confirm that you completed it.
tips: Look for sequence connectors like 'First', 'Next', 'Finally'.
Notice logical steps: check -> print -> attach -> submit -> confirm.

title: Instructions for students starting the course
sentences: When you arrive at the university, go to the help desk.
A member of staff will ask for your name and your address.
He or she will enter your information into the computer and give you an identification card.
You can use this card to borrow books in the library or access the online study materials.
You will find these links on your home page.
tips: Look for logical steps: arrive -> register -> receive card -> use card -> find links.

title: Key card (Thẻ chìa khóa)
sentences: To enter the building and use the lift, you need your key card.
If you lose this, you will need to see the staff member at the front desk.
He or she will ask for your name and flat number and then write them down.
You will also need to show your identification card.
He or she will make a copy of it and give you a new key card.
tips: Follow the sequence: problem -> report -> verify -> show ID -> get new card.

title: Visitors Day at an animal hospital
sentences: When you arrive, go straight to the main office to collect your ticket.
You must show this to the member of staff before going to the hospital.
Inside the building, you will see a photography exhibit.
Before you look at the pictures, a guide will tell you about the day's event.
These activities will include playing and feeding the animals.
tips: Notice the event flow: arrive -> show ticket -> go inside -> listen -> participate.

title: Traffic Problems
sentences: They were out of order for several hours, and the traffic was moving very slowly.
This caused long delays on the roads.
As a result of the delays, many people were not able to get to work on time.
Fortunately, by the evening, the traffic lights worked again.
Therefore, there was no further delay, and people could get home after work.
tips: Follow cause and effect: issue -> consequence -> impact -> fix -> result.

title: Instruction for end of term report
sentences: Before you start to write your report, you should look at websites for the information you need.
Remember to save links to websites and include them in your report.
You should also include a list of books that you use for reference.
When you have finished your report, correct all mistakes.
After you make the corrections, send your report by email.
tips: Process order: research -> save links -> add references -> correct -> send.

title: Printer (Quy trình dùng máy in)
sentences: Firstly, find an appropriate place to put the printer in.
When the printer is in place, turn it on by switching the buttons on the sides.
A light comes on at the front of the printer when the power is on.
If the light is green, the printer is ready to use.
Before using it, remember to put some paper into the tray.
tips: Follow logical setup: place device → power on → check light → confirm ready → add paper.

title: Attending a conference (Tham dự hội nghị)
sentences: When you have a conference pass, go to the lifts on the right.
Take the lift to the third floor and go to the main desk.
Show your pass from the conference to a member of staff at the desk.
He or she will tell you your seat numbers for the talk at the main hall.
Once you are in the hall, someone will help you find your seat.
tips: Think of the sequence: get pass → go upstairs → show pass → get seat info → find your seat.

title: Fire instructions (Hướng dẫn khi gặp hoả hoạn)
sentences: When you hear the alarm, leave your bags and belongings at the desk.
Next, walk calmly to the doors marked 'Emergency Exit.'
Through these doors, you will see the stairs.
When you reach the bottom of these stairs, leave the building through the front entrance.
Outside, gather on the grass and wait for further instructions.
tips: Emergency flow: alarm → exit → stairs → leave building → gather outside.

title: A school science textbook (Sách khoa học trong trường học)
sentences: The first step is to find out how much you know about the problem.
The next one is to form a hypothesis or an idea based on the information you have.
Then, you need to perform experiments to see if these ideas are true or not.
You can also compare your results with experiments in the past.
In this way, you add to the knowledge about the subject for future experiments.
tips: Scientific process: identify problem → form hypothesis → test → compare → expand knowledge.

title: Instructions for submitting files (Hướng dẫn nộp file)
sentences: In your account, press 'open a new window'.
When you do this, a new window will open.
Simply drag or drop your files into the window.
Once the file is there, go back to your account and press the send button to submit.
Finally, check your email for confirmation of submission.
tips: Sequence: open → upload → send → confirm.

title: A famous football player - Zidane
sentences: As a child, he played for several teams close to his home in Marseille.
He then left home to join Cannes Football Club in the south of France.
While he was in the club, he was seen as a talented player.
Later, he left France to advance his career in Italy and Spain, where he eventually stopped playing.
Since retiring, he has worked as a manager for a football club.
tips: Think: childhood → join club → show talent → career abroad → retired manager.

title: Delivery man (Nhân viên giao hàng)
sentences: You should arrive at the main office by 6:30 am and collect your keys.
In the office, you can also collect a map of your route.
You must follow the route on the map to deliver packages.
When you have completed all deliveries, return to your office.
You must return your keys to the office manager after you get back.
tips: Routine: collect → get route → deliver → return → hand back keys.

title: Guides to the Natural History Center (Hướng dẫn đến Trung tâm Lịch sử Tự nhiên)
sentences: The most important of these is the Natural History Center.
The entrance to the center is on the town's main square.
As you enter the square, you will see a set of stairs to your left.
The ticket office is at the top of these steps; the staff there are very helpful.
As well as selling tickets, the staff provide maps and useful tour information.
tips: Direction order: identify → locate → move → reach → get info.

title: Dream of space travel (Ước mơ du hành vũ trụ)
sentences: When she was young, she liked looking at the stars and hoped to visit them.
Because of this, she studied hard at school and university.
Her hard work was successful because American Space invited her.
They invited her to join the team and train.
After one year of training, she was selected from hundreds to fly to the moon.
tips: Progression: dream → study → get invited → train → achieve dream.

title: Early life of Jay Mist (Thời thơ ấu của Jay Mist)
sentences: When he was young, his parents left their country and moved to the United States.
He started his high school and began strength training in his free time.
Jay was very good at that, and he participated in a bodybuilding competition.
At one of these events, an actor agent saw him and gave him a starring role.
tips: Life story: move → train → compete → discovered.

title: How to plant potatoes (Quy trình trồng khoai tây)
sentences: All you need is some earth, a big spot, and some old potatoes.
An old potato has little roots, a little green, and won't be good for eating.
This color means it is perfect for growing; then you dig a hole in the earth and put it deep down.
When you've done this, place it in a sunny place and water it every day.
This care will help the potato grow in a couple of weeks.
tips: Steps: prepare → select → plant → care → grow.

title: The life of Albert Einstein (Cuộc đời của Albert Einstein)
sentences: As a child, he moved to a new city in Germany, where he discovered his love for science and math.
His best friend in his new class shared his interest in inventions and helped him explore new ideas.
She later became his wife, supporting him through his studies and scientific discoveries.
These were so advanced that they changed the way people thought about physics and the universe.
Princeton University in the USA invited him to become a professor for his outstanding scientific discoveries.
tips: Timeline: childhood → friendship → marriage → achievements → recognition.

title: Tom Harper
sentences: When he was young, he began writing short stories for a magazine.
He soon wrote regularly for that magazine, sharing his creative ideas with many readers.
At one point, he almost left his job, but then he decided to create unusual characters.
The characters he imagined became some of the most famous in literature.
This popularity made Tom Harper rich and successful.
tips: Development: start writing → publish → struggle → create success → fame.

title: Race for Charity (Cuộc đua từ thiện)
sentences: On arrival at the park, please go to the information point at the North Gate.
Runners must register here at least half an hour before the race starts at 9 a.m.
To do this, you just need to show your photo card.
In return, a member of staff will give you a numbered armband to wear.
Please put this on immediately and join the others in the warm-up area.
tips: Order: arrive → register → show card → get armband → join warm-up.

title: Betty Barr's life (Cuộc đời của Betty Barr)
sentences: She was born in Shanghai in 1933 to an American mother and a father from Scotland.
At that time, Shanghai was a city filled with many people from different countries.
After she finished her school, she went to Wellesley College, a famous university in the USA.
However, she missed China, and applied for a job in Hong Kong, where she taught from 1959 to 1972, and learned to speak Cantonese, the local language.
In the 1980s, she finally returned to China and still lives with her Shanghai husband, George Wang.
tips: Timeline: born → environment → education → work abroad → return home.

title: My first car (Chiếc ô tô đầu tiên của tôi)
sentences: I had just passed my test, and was excited to begin driving soon.
However, I did not have a car, so I started searching for one immediately.
When I saw an advertisement for a used car, I was interested.
I called the number on the advert to get more information about it.
We agreed on a reasonable price after a short negotiation.
tips: Process: pass test → need car → find ad → contact seller → buy car.

title: Instructions for users of the city car park
sentences: When you arrive, please take a ticket from a machine by the entrance.
This ticket will have information of time and date.
Please display the ticket with this information in the window of your car.
Before you leave, please put the ticket into the machine by the gate.
The machine will read the information on the ticket and show you how much you have to pay.
tips: Steps: take → display → return → pay.

title: Using the public cycle / renting a bike
sentences: Go to the collection point and touch the screen with your bank card.
Choose 'hire the cycle' and follow the instructions to get your release code.
Enter your code in the lock on the bike and wait for the green light.
When the light shows, you can unlock the bike and start your journey.
At the end of your ride, return the bike to any collection point.
tips: Cycle hire steps: tap card → follow steps → unlock → ride → return.

title: Buying a new house (Mua nhà mới)
sentences: The first and most important step is to assess your personal needs carefully.
In order to choose the right place, you must research the neighborhood thoroughly.
The most important factor is the cost of the homes in that area.
Other factors to consider are the availability of schools, parks, and shops nearby.
Such requirements will greatly influence your overall satisfaction and happiness.
tips: Decision process: needs → research → cost → facilities → satisfaction.

title: Instruction to attend the conference (Hướng dẫn tham dự hội nghị)
sentences: When you arrive at the conference hall, show the booking number and then receive a guidebook.
A staff member will note this down and give you a welcoming package.
Inside, you will find a schedule of events and the information of the key speaker.
If you would like to listen to his talk, it is in the main hall.
After he finishes, there will be time for questions.
tips: Steps: check in → receive → read → attend → Q&A.
